rows: - Benchmark (listener, n=5, this sandbox, release build): startup to "listening" 11 to 21 ms (median 13 ms); idle RSS 5.8 to 5.95 MB. The TypeScript listener could not be rebuilt for a like-for-like run (its bundle needed the multi-browser build, which no longer builds from a fresh worktree), so the comparison is a floor: an empty `node` process alone idles at 43.1 MB RSS (n=5, 43.10 to 43.15 MB), more than seven times the whole Rust listener, before zod, the logger or any request. The old image also carried `playwright-core` (14 MB) and sharp with its libvips (19.6 MB) installed by `npm install` only to satisfy imports the listener never used at idle; the new one adds a 5.7 MB binary and keeps `nodejs` only to install the tool CLIs.
